excerpts.text: The Milan village is a brand-new complex that will house 1,500 athletes and team members during the [Feb. 6-22 Milan Cortina Olympics](/olympics/2026-milan-cortina/winter-olympics-sports-events-medal-count-how-to-watch/).

The Olympic village in Milan is just one of [six complexes](/olympics/figure-skating-2026-olympics-full-schedule-how-to-watch-tv-streaming/) housing athletes at the Winter Olympics. A temporary village has been built to house 1,100 athletes and officials in [Cortina,](/olympics/2026-milan-cortina/see-how-athletes-live-cortina-olympic-village/) while hotels and alpine lodges have been adapted in Anterselva and Bormio, each housing 400 participants, and nearly 1,000 in Livigno.
